title: Embedding Geometry Shapes LLM Routing: Experiment Code
description:
Experiment code and reproducibility materials for Embedding Geometry Shapes LLM Routing: Tracing Failure Modes and Improving Generalization.

Includes pinned input manifests, frozen splits, scientific implementations, Slurm launchers, reference results and CPU/GPU component checks. Complete full-scale training and every bootstrap have not all been independently rerun. Leonardo Torti and Emanuele Rimoldi contributed equally.
notes: CC BY 4.0 applies to original project material; third-party exceptions are documented in THIRD_PARTY.md. This metadata file prepares archival and does not indicate that a Zenodo DOI has been issued.
